path.description: Absolute path on the target daemon's file system of any local `.java` file in the target workspace. This path is used to infer the workspace root and locate JDTLS. Relative paths are rejected.

target.description: A raw `jdt://` URI, a complete workspace symbol / definition output line that contains such a URI, a `file://` URI, or an absolute `.class` path on the target daemon's file system. Relative class paths are rejected.
